system.description:
| Mokuton Infusion – Drained / Max Ranks: 5, [Physical], [Mental] / A Drained creature takes 1d8 chakra damage at the start of each of their turns for each rank it has. / A Drained creature increases the chakra damage they take from hostile creatures attacks or jutsu by +2. This increases to +4 at 7th level and +6 at 15th level. / A Drained creature can spend an Action to make a DC 15 Constitution ability check to end this condition. |

3rd Level Clan Feature

Your link to green isn’t an accident. Your chakra doesn’t just build, it grows, sprouts and reveals its beauty and strength. You can control wood and nature like its second nature. Once per turn as part of an attack made with the Attack action while in your Mokuton Infusion stance or when casting a Senju Hijutsu, you can use the New Growth ability.

New Growth. Select a point you can see on the ground within 60 feet of you as you manifest a 10-foot radius patch of almost sentient foliage such as roots, trunks or brambles. Creatures other than you that move through this affected area spends 4 feet for movement for every 1 feet they move as they try to maneuver through this terrain. This special terrain is named New Growth and lasts for 1 minute or until cleared as a result of a damaging effect crossing affected spaces.
